usage: The word '電源' (din6 jyun4) is a noun that refers to the source of electrical power.
'電源' can be used to talk about power supply for various electronic devices like computers, phones, or household appliances.
You can use '電源' when discussing turning something on or off by controlling the power switch.
'電源' is commonly combined with verbs like 打開 (to turn on) or 關掉 (to turn off) when talking about operating devices.
It can also be used metaphorically to mean the origin or source of power in a system.
